subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated. We can't tell if this is a deliberate design call or just a coordination slip in how it was documented.

Sheet A-301 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule; we'll reconcile Sheet A-201 by addendum. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected.
